paragraphs: Rev. Dr. Sam Oye is the Founder and Lead Pastor of The Transforming Church (TTC) in Abuja, Nigeria, and the Convener of Prophetic Prayer Hour (PPH) — an online prayer platform that gathers a global audience.
He is widely known for practical, faith-filled teaching on leadership, relationships, marriage, faith and purpose, shared from the pulpit, online and through the weekly Sam Oye Podcast.
